title: Maximum Total Value
summary: You may select indices a total of at most m times. The t-th selection of index i yields value[i]-decay[i]*(t-1). Choose selections maximizing the ordinary total, then return that optimum modulo 1000000007. Selections are optional; negative rewards need not be taken.
officialConstraints: Equal array lengths 1..100000; values and decay 1..10^9; m 1..10^9.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
